additional_info.subject: RE: ID0391381-DC/SI-D/AE-[Unknown]-meter reading unable read in OCPP backend CRM:01282000660
additional_info.body:
Hello Basheer,
Thanks for sharing the serial number.
At first, I would highlight that the backend is not in the successfully integrated backend list for Sicharge D :
Backend Integrations
,
Having said that, I tried to search the logs from 20/11/24 till 23/11/24, here are my findings:
The charger is manufactured without the LEM; hence Sicharge D will not send any MeterValues with
Energy.Active.Import.Register,
measurand -
Energy.Active.Import.Register & Energy.Active.Import.Interval
are not configured by OCPP backend in the
MeterValuesSampledData
. Ask your customer to add these two measurand in MeterValuesSampledData by using ChangeConfiguration. However, please keep point 1 in mind.
MeterValueSampleInterval
was 0 in the begining - Please set it to 30, 60 or any value as per backend need.
The OCPP operator can't see recurring the kWh being delivered (e.g 1min cycle) i.e.
Energy.Active.Import.Register
They could still the energy at start (always start with 0 ) and at the end of session (with actual energy consumed).
In this case the Meter start (at StartTransaction) is always 0
Meter Stop (at StopTransaction) will be equal to energy delivered
Energy.Active.Import.Interval
-> This can be configured to know whole energy delivered within the session.
Hope this explains, if your CPO has furthermore questions, we suggest proposing a backend integration for detailed integration test and answerind customer queries.
Let me know if we are good to close the case.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Sharma
